newsitem.title: UK: ABF shares gain as results please.
newsitem.headline: ABF shares gain as results please.

text.p: Share in Associated British Foods Plc rose on Monday after the company posted a better-than- expected 14.7 percent rise in annual pre-tax profit and said it was seeking further acquisitions in the UK and overseas.
The stock was up 9p at 426 by 1417 GMT in moderate volume of 1.63 million shares, after earlier reaching a seven-month high of 427p.

ABF pre-tax profit rose to 430 million stg in the year to September 14 from 375 million a year before, with profits driven by a strong performance from the company's retail operations in Britain and Ireland.
Analysts said the results were above expectations and were also marked by improving margins in the milling and baking businesses.
"It is obviously a fairly strong and sturdy business," said Carl Short, analyst at SocGen. "ABF also has 800 million stg cash in the bank at a time when interest rates are trending upwards."
